snippet.title: Yars Rising - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump into the action as Emi fights her way through Qotech. Run, jump, sneak, and hack through enemies and bosses in Yars Rising. This brand new Metroidvania from Atari and WayForward is coming soon. 

Wishlist Yars Rising: https://link.atari.com/wishlist-yars 

Join the conversation on Discord: https://discord.gg/atariclub
